sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient, SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS percentage FROM Patient
